title: The 8 Core Academy Modules
description: Every candidate enrolled in SLEDMC Academy completes a rigorous preparation path engineered specifically for European employer demands.

modules.title: European Language Preparation
modules.desc: Targeted language instruction to ensure conversational, workplace, and technical fluency across European destinations.

modules.title: European Culture & Workplace Integration
modules.desc: Cross-cultural training designed to align Sri Lankan candidates with European social norms, legal obligations, and workplace dynamics.

modules.title: Employment & Workers' Rights
modules.desc: Empowering workers with thorough knowledge of legal employment rights, contract safety, and anti-exploitation safeguards.

modules.title: Documentation & Mobility Preparation
modules.desc: Ensuring candidates possess 100% compliant, legalized, and verified documentation prior to visa submission and travel.

modules.title: Professional Job-Specific Training
modules.desc: Hands-on vocational enhancement aligned with European employer operational standards and equipment.

modules.title: Employability & Interview Skills
modules.desc: Preparing candidates to present their experience convincingly in direct employer video and practical interviews.
items: Digital Video Interview Readiness & Tech Setup
Role-Specific Mock Interviews with European Trainers

modules.title: Financial & Independent Living Skills
modules.desc: Guiding candidates on practical living essentials to foster smooth personal independence upon relocation.
items: Personal Budgeting & Cost of Living Management
Public Utilities, Transportation Cards & Mobile Plans

modules.title: Pre-Departure & Arrival Orientation
modules.desc: Comprehensive final preparation ensuring smooth transit, airport reception, and initial onboarding in Europe.
